title: Port
description: <port>/port.json: what is being ported, from which commit, and how its tests run. Written once by `start`; read by every later step.

format_version.description: Version of this file's format. Readers refuse any value other than 1.

source_url.description: Git URL or local path the checkout was cloned from.

commit.description: Full 40-character hash of the pinned commit. `checkout/` is detached at it and `original_source/` is exported from it.

adapter.description: Source-language adapter that runs every language-specific step of this port.

name.description: Registry name passed to `load_adapter`, such as "python".

interface_version.description: Adapter interface version the port was started with; see reference/adapter-interface.md.

test_command.description: Command that runs the original tests, one argument per item, run from `checkout/` with the port environment's interpreter in place of `python`.

test_paths.description: Test files and folders, relative to `checkout/`, that the oracle runs and checks are unchanged.

test_requirements.description: Requirement specifiers the original tests need, installed into the port environment.

import_names.description: Top-level import names the original package provides.
